problems.name: Unverified literals and over-narrow projections ship silently: the harness never executes the draft, so 0-row results from trailing-space/case-mismatched string filters and name-only SELECTs are returned unchecked.

attempts.what: solve.py now executes the first draft; only when it errors or returns 0 rows does it spend the second policy call on a repair prompt that tells the model to re-check quoted literals (stray spaces, casing, stored abbreviations) against real values and to widen the projection to...
